rationale: The agent initiated and submitted a return without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the confirmation requirement. It also failed to answer the user’s first request about how many t-shirt options are available. While the agent did appear to identify the user and access their orders, and returned the specified items from a single order, the lack of pre-action confirmation and the omission of the t-shirt count mean the request was not completed in line with policy. The statement about refunding to a specific card may be correct but is not clearly supported by visible tool outputs here. Overall, these issues warrant a fail.
